source: McAuley Amazon Reviews 2023（公开研究数据集）
reviews: My husband has many, many Dewalt drills, but none are "approved" for me to use. Thus, he purchased this one for me. It's a very, very nice sturdy little drill. Comes with a lovely canvas bag, two batteries and a charger. I was surprised to find that both batteries were fully charged when they arrived. I haven't had a project to use it on yet, but I feel very well set when I do. Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

This thing is almost big as the 6ah battery size but this one is with more capacity and feels like it's almost the same weight as well I only use this for stuff like that uses more power such as the air inflator or the high torque impact driver so I know I have enough power to cover my project and yes it delivers as promised.

Terrible quality. Something inside The drill is wobbly. When you try to drill a hole the you can visibly see the drill bit making a circle. Plus I don't know how they do it but every attachment is super weak. The drill bits break off when I try to screw a screw into a board. One time while I was trying to drill a hole into something the drill bit bend in half and I cut my hand. Do not buy this junk just because it is pink.

I used the one I purchased for a switch box, mounting 3 separate switches in the cover. It drills very easy taking only seconds to drill the 1/2 inch holes needed for my switch mountings. I also needed to drill a hole in one corner for power wiring access, again very easy to do. Works like a charm, nice appearance.
Purchased these to go with a Dewalt shop vacuum that we bought. Fits as it should and works as it should. Makes it easier to clean out the vacuum container in my opinion.

I've had two of these batteries for my Porter Cable drill fail. They're not cheap. One was still under warranty, but I had to pay for this one. I guess we'll have to see if this one lasts. The drill has seen far too little use for it to have eaten two batteries already.
Liked the fact that they included a drill bit to drill holes in my bookcase for the shelf supports. These are nice and will definitely hold a shelf with a lot of weight (books in my cae) on it.

My husband uses these in his shop to organize his huge collection of drill bits and other. They are tough, thick canvas and the zippers are sturdy. He like the different primary colors too - works as part of his organization. He knows which bits, etc are in each using the color. Having said all of this, we never hesitate to update our reviews should new info seem useful.

My husband bought me a dewalt driver and this set to compliment the driver (that I call a drill). It's a LOT of bits and pieces that you need if you're gonna use in household projects. It comes in a very organized hard plastic case. I was hoping that it would fit in my canvas drill tool bag, but it is WAY too big for that. That's ok. I like that it's all organized and I can easily see and grab whatever I might need.
Purchased this set to go with our dewalt wet/dry vac. Work great and really useful if you're using to vacuum your car - which we are.

I bought this to use as an option to buy larger circular saw. I'm so happy with this! So much easier to use. The blades are easy to change, it's much lighter than my Circular so my cuts are more precise. It's got a lazer to use to keep your lines straight that works amazing unless you're in the sun. Overall, I love it. So far I haven't found anything I can't use it for. If you're looking for a smaller saw, this is it!

I do diamond painting and this is perfect for pressing down the sections of drills as they are done ...........i have one of these around here somewhere but it was easier to just buy a new one than to find it ! i bought one for me and this order was for a friend who does diamond painting too so i surprised her with one as well it works FABULOUS to pressing down the stones

These are a perfect fit for hard gun cases or any other type of hard case. I used a 3/8 inch drill bit to widen the holes on my gun cases and that allowed a perfect fit for the shackles. The length of the shackle allows for an upside-down position of the locks to make access to the keyholes much easier than turning the case upside down each time.
These people stand behind their word got a new drill works awesome thank you God bless
Has a bit more juice than the original batteries my drill cam with. Over all a good value. I needed a back up for the two I have. A bit cheaper than the OME.

I dont normally abuse my 3/8 sets so I thing this will last me for a while. I have had the 1/2 equivalent for over 5 years now and use it about once a week on average. I believe this smaller set will get about the same use since most work now is done with power tools and these sockets dont have a way of adapting.

Use it for small jobs and works really good only thing is it does not have a battery status led for battery life so that’s the reason it gets four stars I don’t know why black and decker wouldn’t put them on the drill. After 2 months of use had to drop the star cause it's really not meant for everyday use if used almost everyday the gear will start slipping so not for everyday use, it's for homeowner's use.

This is a very sturdy ceiling fan. You’ll need a screwdriver and a drill to assemble. The red is much more vibrant than I expected. It comes with an LED Edison lightbulb. One side of the fan blades is a dark walnut color. The other side is an ebony wood grain. It also comes with fan blade weights in case you have wobble once it is installed. I didn’t need them. It looks great. And it works really well.

Life saver didn’t have to replace my 20-yr old drill when the old charger actually broke when it got knocked off onto the concrete floor. I only use it for light household jobs like putting up shelves but I do like the drill. I’ve had a workman offer to buy it but I won’t part with it.

Bought with hesitation but works great for my little lady’s hands to do all kinds of drilling. Worth your investment if you do your own work as it is worth the attachments & bits too. Love the link for my lady’s taste makes a great gift for holidays & birthdays too

I ordered 1/4" spacers but received 3/8" spacers; secondly each spacer has small holes at the top and bottom to accept screws that attach the receptacle to the electric box - but these holes are too small for the typical #6 screws used and I had to drill them out to make them work.

This was exactly what I needed to finalize my bathroom renovation. It was the perfect size for drilling the drain hole in my countertop for the new sink. When using just make sure to keep it cooled with water since the friction causes it to heat very quickly.

Very Beautiful but i measured my center holes in correctly. they are 2.25 inch and handle is 2.5 inch. My fault there so I drilled out the holes in the furniture to make it fit. Only downside was no screws with handle so had to purchase them. Not a big deal not expensive. I love the handle. It truly makes a big difference on my furniture piece. I would purchase again.

Plenty of power & torque Just used it to remove Lugnuts of my 24-year-old tractor tires No struggle with breaker bars using regular lug wrench. My brother liked so much I got him one also he loves it have been impressed with all of the Ryobi tools, much cheaper than Dewalt and just as good

Husband reports that work ok. Putting a shank on a drill bit might a good idea, but it's too positive to keep from snapping bits off. Not great for his use, but may be for others - thus the 4 star review. Having said this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

Very simple to use and lightweight. Just charge with included USB cord and insert the tip you want, select the direction and you are ready to go. Seems sufficiently powerful for most applications. Beats using an old corded drill.
Good adhesion and no drilling in the RV. Perfect

I’ve used this to clean hair out of or upstairs bathroom that is mainly used by our kids. Works great and is much better than using other drain cleaners. Connected easy to my drill and was about to pull out a bunch of gunk. Very pleased.

Great impact, have used a similar Milwaukee, what I like about this is the three different speeds. I do recommend this. When I bought this it was an Amazon deal and I had been looking to buy this for some time. Decided to buy it and i am really pleased with the purchase. I have used it removing spindle hub nuts and wheels lug nuts. I don't do commercial engines like 18 wheeler tractors but for most automobile work I recommend.

I’m not a power tools guru. I don’t know anything about the specs of equiptment. I just know if something works or it doesn’t. This saw works. I haven’t had a single problem with it. Of course, I’m doing small craft type jobs with it and not hardcore woodworking. But it absolutely works for me.

A 1/4 drill bit was not as snug as I’d prefer, and 7/32 works much better. The hooks were easy to screw in after drilling pilot holes. These hooks securely hold a 30 lb mountain bike, and I’m sure they could handle more with no problem.

This works perfectly in my Dewalt DWE7480 table saw. It is easy to adjust (which you really only need to do once). The time consuming part is making a sled to take advantage of the tight fit in the miter slot. I know some reviews have said parts were missing, but the one I received had everything that the packaging said was included.

Don't waste your time or money on this piece of crap made by Harbor Freight Tools (HFT #66262). I had to return it because the snake portion is weak and developed a kink right off the bat. The drill attachment portion is very small and also weak. It should have been made with a substantial attachment for adequate torque. I wasted my time and money, don't say I didn't tell you not to buy this.

I wanted a basic, lightweight, corded drill and this is it. You will need to keep the chuck key handy as this does not hand tighten. It is comfortable for my girlie hands and easy for me to keep a stable pressure on without having to muscle it around. I like it.
Awesome brand for tools- this is a small set but worth it. And the best part about these Dewalt sets is that if you buy other ones you can connect them to make one big tool box.
Bought this for hubby, he loves it. Powerful, yet lightweight, even I can use it. Battery life is good, and all around great drill for the money.

Small center drill bit comes loose and needs to be retightened. Worked fine, if I were going to use it everyday I would have bought a better one with more teeth. The price was good for intermittent use.

I LOVE this drill set. It is easy to use and came with pretty much all I needed for small jobs around the house and at my cabin. I have used the drill many times as well as the hand tools. The battery has held a charge for quite a while also.

These hangers were perfect for the vinyl siding on my home. Since I can never decide on the perfect place to hang things, I didn't dare drill holes into the vinyl. These were great because if I had the right height, I could just slide the hangers to the place I wanted for the decor. Then as I changed out the decor, they removed easily without any damage to the vinyl or the hangers and I could use them again.
batteries worked great / used for cordless drill combo set
